meaning:
ἡδύ-οσμος, -ον
(ἡδύς, ὀσμή)
sweet-smelling; as subst., τὸ ἡ., mint: Mat.23:23, Luk.11:42.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and…
But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left…
